verdict.rationale: Notte's docs state that it persists cookies and login state across sessions, and its site advertises "Authenticated Profiles" (browser profiles for each agent). Together these directly cover reusable logged-in profiles that let agents skip the login wall on later runs. Both are only short landing-page-level claims, so depth is unverified. Missing for 10: detailed profile docs (API/SDK usage for creating, saving and reusing profiles, expiry/refresh behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration.
